verdict: Organic visibility is softening across all three entities this week.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, Google Business Profile and organic search remain the only active channels — no paid spend ran during the last 28 days. GBP engagement declined across all three entities in the most recent 7 days, with O'Hare seeing the sharpest drop at 56%, AGS down 30%, and Forte down 9%; search clicks followed the same downward trend. The root cause of the organic visibility softening is under active investigation, and a web/SEO fix is being finalized for submission this period. A number of CRM, outreach, and automation workstreams that unlock the next phase of lead generation are being resolved this month, with key milestones targeted for October 31.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three entities in the last 28 days (directions, calls, and web clicks combined)
drop in O'Hare GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 — the steepest single-week decline across the group
paid leads generated this period — no Meta or Google Ads spend was active across any entity

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement and organic search clicks are declining week-over-week across all three entities, with O'Hare and AGS showing confirmed multi-day drops to zero activity.
watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root-cause fix is being submitted this period, and GBP listing optimization is underway to stabilize impressions and recover engagement heading into November.
